name: Map Annotations To ISXD Data

params.name: ISXD File(s)
params.description: ISXD files. Can be a single file, or a series.

params.name: Annotations File(s)
params.description: Annotations in IDEAS format. File(s) with time column and a column specifying annotations at each time point.

params.name: Time Column
params.description: Name of column in input annotations files specifying timestamps to use for mapping to ISXD data.

params.name: State Column
params.description: Name of column in input annotations files specifying state annotations

params.name: GPIO File
params.description: Gpio file to use as time-reference for the input annotations. A time offset is automatically computed between the gpio file and the input isxd files. This time offset is used to align the input annotations to the input isxd files from the channel specified by 'Channel Name'. Only applicable for third-party annotations.

params.name: Channel Name
params.description: Specifies the channel to automatically compute the time offset if a gpio file is provided as time-reference. The channel name must be present in the gpio file.

params.name: Channel Threshold
params.description: If a gpio file is provided as a time-reference, this parameter specifies an optional threshold to apply on the gpio reference channel. The time offset will be computed from the first sample in the channel which is greater than or equal to the threshold. If empty, use the timestamp of the first sample in the channel to compute the time offset.

params.name: Manual Time Offset
params.description: Specifies a time offset, in seconds, to manually set between the input annotations and the input isxd files. Only applicable for third-party annotations

params.name: Use Hardware TSC Alignment
params.description: Whether to align annotations using hardware counter timestamps (TSC). If enabled and hardware counter metadata is missing from the reference ISXD file, the tool fails. If disabled, the tool falls back to alignment using the start time of the reference ISXD file.

results.name: Experiment Annotations File
results.description: PARQUET file containing annotations, synchronized to ISXD cell set file

description: Map frames from experiment annotations in IDEAS format to frames in ISXD data (either movies or cell sets)
